subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of the current onboarding refresh, or should this branch be paused/closed in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining question is not just mechanical: the PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, conflict resolution, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a smaller follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want after the current onboarding refresh and leave connection-path/short-code work to the focused PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh and open focused onboarding PRs as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, conflict resolution, and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged startup-routing fix is on the same user-path boundary and is the clearest current-main ownership signal for the product decision.
